__note: Scan-detection fixtures for test/test-changed.test.mjs. They live in a JSON fixture rather than in the test source on purpose: the router treats a `git ls-files`/`git archive`/`git grep` call as a repo-wide dependency of the whole tree, and a test file whose STRING DATA contains that call pattern is indistinguishable from one that performs it. Keeping the fixtures here (JSON is not a scanned module) stops test/test-changed.test.mjs from becoming a sweep test that runs on every change.
